asset_research_plan.decision: Build asset-domain campaign planning for bounded batches, per-target limits, backoff and resumable progress while delegating durable dispatch and authentication to the existing platform.
questions: Which batch/concurrency/time/traffic limits protect the chosen authorized lab/device classes?
How can incremental collection avoid repeatedly reading unchanged fields while respecting fresh-evidence needs?
How will offline assets, partial results, duplicate intents, retries and exhausted budgets appear without false success?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Report campaign throughput, fairness, collected bytes/probe counts and failures separately; state the largest measured scope.
cases: Crash/replay intent preparation and verify no duplicate semantic collection intent.
Enforce per-target/global limits and stop dispatch intent generation when cancelled or out of budget.
Unavailable assets retain failed/unknown states and cannot appear freshly collected.
consumers: C22: campaign constraints, replay/failure outcomes and measured collection cost.
P07/P08: collection intents through the existing durable-job and runner trust contracts.
Shams’s asset operators: pause/resume/unknown-state evidence without a second queue.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Omar checks ledger/envelope reuse; Amr reviews authorized lab load assumptions without taking collection ownership.
asset_research_plan.start: Post-first-slice: complete C20, P07, P08, C04 first; draft research/fixtures earlier without claiming measured completion.
